title: ArchKeel report v2 payload
description: AD-361. One payload, two readers: the page renders it, and the host prints its head (run, summary, rules, gaps and the node 0 rows of measures). It derives from the record sections of architecture.json, the contract as recorded there, and the rule rows of the evaluator. The tables are columnar: integer ids and codes and one string table. No path record and no reachability pair. Canonical bytes: keys in the order of `required` (the optional fields and params after carriers), no whitespace, UTF-8, a string escapes only the quote, the backslash and U+0000 to U+001F (as \b \f \n \r \t or \u00xx with lowercase hex), no Unicode normalisation, integers only in the tables, one trailing newline.

schema_version.description: Semver. This schema accepts every 2.x payload. A reader accepts its own major version and shows a visible message for any other.

trend.description: Oldest first. Empty or one point means no trend (G-TREND).

strings.description: The one string table of the tables. Unique, sorted by UTF-8 bytes.

nodes.description: The containment tree. `parent` is the component tree: a module belongs to its innermost owning component, else to the system; a component to its parent component, else to the system; a package to its enclosing package, else to the system. `package` links a module to its package. No ancestor or reachability pair is stored. Columns have equal length. Row order: level, then depth, then key by UTF-8 bytes; a parent comes before its children.

key.description: Stable identity for the URL and for trend: "" for the system, "package:", "component:" or "module:" and the name.

package.description: The package node of a module; -1 for other nodes.

fan_in.description: Distinct modules outside the node that import a module under it.

fan_out.description: Distinct modules outside the node that a module under it imports.

measures.description: One row per node and measure that applies; a missing row means not applicable. Integers only: a ratio is value and of. Columns have equal length. Row order: node, then measure.

gap.description: Set for unknown and undeclared; G-BUDGETS for a measured value without budget and baseline.

budget_source.description: The id of the evaluated contract rule that sets the budget.

verdict.description: `none` without a budget or a baseline.

units.description: Definitions. Columns have equal length. Row order: module, then line, then name, then kind, then record id.

decl.description: The first evidence line without leading and trailing ASCII spaces and tabs, cut at 72 Unicode code points, not normalised.

variants.description: Enum variants. Columns have equal length. Row order: unit, then declaration order.

edges.description: Direct edges only. The page computes reachability and cycles from these rows. `target` is the permission of the component pair (allowed: declared, forbidden: forbidden, undecided: undeclared); a module edge has the target of the component pair at the first level where the two owner chains differ. An allowed pair without an observed edge is a component edge with zero sites. Columns have equal length. Row order: module edges first, then component, then package; inside a level by from, then to.

names.description: Distinct crossing names, including the omitted ones.

sites.description: Import sites. 0: declared and not observed.

omitted.description: Crossings left out by the cap of 200 per module edge.

via_end.description: End offset into `via`. The module edges of edge i are via[via_end[i-1] .. via_end[i]].

via.description: Module edge indexes, flat. A crossing is stored once, on its module edge.

crossings.description: The names that cross a module edge; "*" is a whole-module import. Columns have equal length. Row order: edge, then name.

findings.description: Typed values only; each reader composes its own title. A hub has value at least `absolute` and at least `relative_permille` of `pool`. Columns have equal length. Row order: disposition, then kind, then value descending, then subject.

gap.description: The gap that keeps the declared block of a hub empty (G-PUBLIC-API, G-ROLES, G-NO-CONTRACT); -1 for a cycle.

permissions.description: The permission of each ordered pair of sibling components, the decision of report --only architecture. A forbidden dependency rule forbids; else a complete_requires rule of the level forbids a pair without requires; else requires or an allowed dependency rule allows; else undecided. Columns have equal length. Row order: component, then target.

rule.description: The deciding rule id; -1 when only a requires entry allows the pair or nothing decides it.

violations.description: One row per violation record, the fields of archkeel.api.load_violations. A row owns violation_rules[rules_end[i-1] .. rules_end[i]], and the same for subjects and evidence. Columns have equal length. Row order: record id.

source_component.description: The top-level component that alone claims source_module.

line.description: Line of the first evidence, or -1.

node.description: The module node of the source module or the first subject.

violation_rules.description: Flat rule ids of the violation rows.

violation_subjects.description: Flat subjects of the violation rows.

violation_evidence.description: Flat evidence ids of the violation rows.

unknowns.description: Why a fact or a verdict is unknown: each record of the unknowns section and each coverage failure (source record), each diagnostic of the run (source diagnostic), and a run without Target (source run). Columns have equal length. Row order: source, then node, then reason, then kind, then detail, then rule.

kind.description: The raw kind; it keeps a reason `other` readable.

node.description: The module, file or package that the row names; else the system.

rule.description: The first rule id of the record.

detail.description: The record title or the claim of the diagnostic.

carriers.description: The names that carry a fan-in hub, at most 6 per finding. Columns have equal length. Row order: finding, then importers descending, then name.

fields.description: Optional, after carriers. An absent table means that fields are not collected (`run.not_carried`). Columns have equal length. Row order: unit, then declaration order.

params.description: Optional, after fields. An absent table means that signatures are not collected. pos -1 is the return type. Columns have equal length. Row order: unit, then pos.

Id.description: Row index into the table that the column names.

Level.description: Code = position in x-codes. Within a major version a new value is only appended, so a 2.x payload validates against every 2.y schema. A reader shows a code beyond its own list as unknown, never as clean.

Measure.description: Code = position in x-codes. Within a major version a new value is only appended, so a 2.x payload validates against every 2.y schema. A reader shows a code beyond its own list as unknown, never as clean. `x-measures` holds the text of each measure; the readers show it, the payload holds none.

x-measures.title: Modules with one owner and no open question
x-measures.numerator: modules that exactly one component owns and that no ranked finding names

x-measures.title: Modules owned by exactly one component
x-measures.numerator: modules that exactly one component owns

x-measures.title: Components that state what they do and what they never do
x-measures.numerator: components with at least one responsibility and one forbidden responsibility

x-measures.title: Modules within the line budget
x-measures.numerator: modules with code_lines at most the budget (500, AD-314)

x-measures.title: Observed component edges that the contract declares
x-measures.numerator: observed component edges with a requires entry
x-measures.denominator: observed component edges whose source is under this node

x-measures.title: Crossing names inside the declared public API
x-measures.numerator: names imported from outside that the public_api list holds
x-measures.denominator: names imported from outside into a component with a public_api list

x-measures.title: Public items that another node imports
x-measures.numerator: top-level public units that a module outside this node imports
x-measures.denominator: top-level public units under this node

x-measures.title: Crossing names bound to a definition
x-measures.numerator: imported names (without whole-module imports) bound to one definition
x-measures.denominator: imported names on module edges with an end under this node

x-measures.title: Crossing names that are data
x-measures.numerator: bound crossing names of kind struct, enum, type alias or constant
x-measures.denominator: crossing names bound to a definition

x-measures.title: Public functions with parsed parameter and return types
x-measures.numerator: public functions and methods with complete parsed signatures

x-measures.title: Crossing data types that the contract declares
x-measures.numerator: crossing data types in the declared boundary types

x-measures.title: Measures of this node that are observed
x-measures.numerator: measures of the other panels in state measured
x-measures.denominator: measures of the other panels in state measured or unknown

Gap.description: Code = position in x-codes. Within a major version a new value is only appended, so a 2.x payload validates against every 2.y schema. A reader shows a code beyond its own list as unknown, never as clean. `x-gaps` holds the text of each gap; the readers show it, the payload holds none.

x-gaps.title: No line count per module
x-gaps.reason: The module record has no code_lines, so the report cannot apply the line budget of AD-314.
x-gaps.remedy: Write code_lines per module, without test-only spans.

x-gaps.title: No parsed signatures in the payload
x-gaps.reason: The payload carries no parameter and return types, so it cannot say which data types a function takes or gives.
x-gaps.remedy: Write parsed parameters and returns, and add the params table.

x-gaps.title: An imported name is not bound to its definition
x-gaps.reason: The import record has no origin_definition. A name that reaches its definition through a re-export stays unbound.
x-gaps.remedy: Write origin_definition for each resolved import and follow re-exports.

x-gaps.title: No use sites below the import
x-gaps.reason: The payload carries no references or calls, so it says "imported by" and never "used by".
x-gaps.remedy: Write reference records and add their count per crossing.

x-gaps.title: No public_api list
x-gaps.reason: The contract names the direction (requires) and not the names that may cross.
x-gaps.remedy: Add a public_api list to the component.

x-gaps.title: No declared data types on the boundary
x-gaps.reason: The contract declares no boundary types, so the report cannot say which crossing types are intended.
x-gaps.remedy: Declare the boundary types of each component.

x-gaps.title: No budget or baseline
x-gaps.reason: No contract rule and no configured budget sets a limit for this measure, so it has no verdict (AD-21).
x-gaps.remedy: Set a budget, or record the current value as the baseline.

x-gaps.title: No earlier measure points
x-gaps.reason: A trend needs the measures of earlier commits. This payload has fewer than two points.
x-gaps.remedy: Keep the measures of each main commit and pass them to the producer.

x-gaps.title: Excluded files are not in the record sections
x-gaps.reason: architecture.json does not record the files that the configuration excludes, so the payload cannot count them.
x-gaps.remedy: Record the excluded files in the report and copy the count.

x-gaps.title: No contract
x-gaps.reason: The run has no contract, so every measure that needs a declaration has no target.
x-gaps.remedy: Write a contract with archkeel init.

x-gaps.title: No contract line for a declared edge
x-gaps.reason: The declarations section records no line of the contract file, so the page cannot link a requires entry or a permission to its line.
x-gaps.remedy: Record the line of each declaration and add a contract_line column to edges and permissions.

x-gaps.title: No declared role or public_api list for this finding
x-gaps.reason: A hub finding can be declared only when the contract states the role or the public_api list of its component (AD-NEW-6), so its declared block stays empty.
x-gaps.remedy: Declare the role (kernel, orchestrator, facade) and the public_api list of the component.

OptGap.description: A code of Gap, or -1 for absent.

language.description: The `runtime.name` of architecture.json, such as python, rust, typescript or dart.

contract.description: null for a run without a contract (explore). Then every measure that needs a declaration is undeclared.

target.description: false: the run has no Target (explore, AD-285); the status is UNKNOWN and an unknowns row of source run says so.

observation.description: The completeness verdict of the observation, copied from the Decision of the evaluator.

not_ranked.description: Derived shapes that are never ranked while their rule passes, such as a package cycle that exists only in the roll-up.

not_carried.description: Relations that this payload does not carry. The page shows each one as "not collected yet" and never draws it. Ascending codes.

payload_budget.description: The producer fails the run above max_bytes and never truncates in silence.

Run.description: No producer name, version or timestamp: the Python oracle and the Rust core write the same bytes.

status.description: The status of the Decision. It follows from the rows by the rule of AD-361: no Target gives UNKNOWN; a violation row gives FAIL, unless the observation is incomplete and a diagnostic revokes the proofs; an incomplete observation gives UNKNOWN; a rule with an undecided position or an UNKNOWN verdict gives UNKNOWN; else PASS.

counts.description: `cycles` leaves out the package cycles that exist only in the roll-up; `run.not_ranked` counts them.

Summary.description: What the host prints, with `run`, `rules`, `gaps` and the `measures` rows of node 0. Typed fields only: each reader composes its own text. Never a score.

evaluated.description: false forces a verdict other than PASS: a rule without an evaluator receipt never shows PASS (AD-117).

violations.description: Violation rows that cite this rule.

undecided.description: Positions that the evaluator left undecided for this rule (AD-92).

reason.description: Why the verdict is what it is, as a code of the Decision.

RuleResult.description: One rule row of the evaluator, copied and never decided by the producer. Order: id.

blocks.description: Measure rows that the gap blocks.

GapRow.description: One gap that this payload references. Order: gap code.

role.description: From the contract; null when the contract declares none.

public_api.description: The flat public_api list of the contract, or null when the contract has none.

Component.description: Contract text of one component node. Order: node.

TrendPoint.description: The system measures of one earlier commit. Columns have equal length.
